data.name: Ubab
data.long_meaning: Ubab is derived from the Arabic word 'Abu' which means 'father' and 'Bab' which means 'gate'. The name Ubab thus signifies 'Servant of Allah' or 'Gatekeeper of Allah'. This name is often given to boys as a sign of their dedication to Allah and their role as protectors and caretakers.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ubab is a spiritual name that signifies devotion and service to Allah. It is a reminder of one's duty to Allah and the importance of living a righteous and pious life.
